updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Purview is enhancing audit logging to provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions within the compliance portal. This improvement helps administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes more effectively.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Entra GSA Network Layer Integration
updates.summary: Purview DLP is being integrated with Entra Internet Access to detect and protect sensitive data at the network layer, including text and AI interactions across browsers, apps, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This extends data security enforcement beyond applications to network traffic, helping prevent data exfiltration to untrusted cloud services.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview is enhancing DLP inline protection for Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business by integrating with Conditional Access controls and expanding policy capabilities. Admins now have access to more granular conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and enhanced visibility into rule matches through activity explorer.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: The maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive has increased from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This enables organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster, reducing labeling gaps across existing content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Optical Character Recognition Support for DLP in SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Purview is adding optical character recognition (OCR) capabilities to detect sensitive content embedded in images within SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business. DLP policies can now automatically prevent exfiltration of sensitive data found in JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, and PDF formats.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Collection and DLP Policies for Intune-Managed Apps
updates.summary: Purview DLP is expanding to Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling content-aware protection policies on mobile devices. Clipboard actions in managed mobile apps will now be evaluated against DLP policies before sharing, reducing data leakage and insider risk on mobile platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - File Testing Against Sensitive Information Classifiers
updates.summary: A new testing capability allows users to validate files against all available classifiers on the Classification page. Administrators can test single or multiple classifiers to identify sensitive content and troubleshoot classification issues more efficiently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding Note Capabilities Across Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows analysts to add collaborative notes directly within alerts to document investigation progress and share findings. System-generated notes automatically record status changes and user assignments, creating an auditable investigation timeline within the alert interface.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Enhanced User Profile Context in IRM Alerts
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management alerts now display more detailed user profile information directly in the workflow, including employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, and priority user status. This enriched context helps investigators build a complete understanding of users without leaving the alert experience.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels - Block All Connected Experiences Analyzing Content
updates.summary: The 'Prevent some connected experiences that analyze content' label setting in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint now prevents files from being sent to all Microsoft connected experiences for analysis, providing stronger privacy controls. Previously this setting only blocked a subset of connected experiences.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) are now accessible through Microsoft Graph APIs, providing a unified view across multiple physical mailboxes. This modernization addresses the deprecation of EWS Graph APIs and improves the developer experience for archive management.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now exceed the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability is available for eligible E5 licensees.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers - Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new compliance report capability helps identify SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply with Information Barriers policies after policy changes. This enables admins to quickly discover and remediate compliance gaps.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96940: Microsoft Exchange Server Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A weak authorization vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to escalate privileges over the network. This affects access control and requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.
